text:
Maya C: Dropping the launch post + mini mailer + a 150-word press snippet for quick review. Need legal quick-pass, final CTAs, and inbound routing for leads. Target publish Tues 10am PT.

Maya C: EMAIL SUBJECT DRAFT:
```
Redwood Inference: Faster, predictable LLM inference for production teams — Join our launch webinar
```
EMAIL HERO (short): Redwood Inference helps teams cut inference cost and stabilize latency at scale. Register for the launch webinar or try the API.
CTA 1: Register for webinar -> /signup?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=launch_2026&utm_medium=newsletter
CTA 2: Try the API -> /signup?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=launch_2026&utm_medium=try

PRESS SNIPPET (150w max):
```
Redwood Inference today launches a developer-first inference platform that provides hosted, dedicated, and private options to run large language models with production-grade latency and cost controls. The platform includes model lifecycle tooling, intelligent batching, and observability to help engineering teams deliver consistent inference economics across environments. Follow our launch webinar to see benchmarks and get started. (more at https://redwood.com)
```

Jon P: Nice first pass. Quick ask — can we include a one-line bench claim in the hero? e.g., "Cut per-token cost by up to X vs default".

Sophia L: We should avoid an unqualified "X" claim in the public hero. Legal will want the benchmark link + test conditions. Suggest: "lower unit cost in production workloads" and link to bench doc.

Cleo G: tagging @legal — I can run a quick pass. Also add HubSpot UTMs and hidden field for routing. Recommend hidden field: product_launch=launch_apr2026 so SDRs can segment.

Alex R: For inbound routing: SDR ops prefers hidden field + assignable lead owner via HubSpot workflow. Proposed workflow name: "Launch - API Trial Routing (Apr2026)" — route to Queue: launch-apr26-sdr. Also confirm webinar registrants go to nurture list.

press-bot: Automated check: press snippet length 147 words — OK. Recommend cutting one sentence if you want a 100-word embargoed teaser.

Maya C: Updated per notes: changed hero to "lower unit cost" + added bench link: https://redwood.in/bench/launch-bench.pdf. Updated CTAs to include exact UTM string. Pasting new press teaser (100 words) below for press list: 
```
Redwood Inference launches a production-focused runtime and control plane for LLM inference. The platform offers hosted, dedicated, and private deployments with workload-aware batching, KV caching, and routing policies to balance latency and cost. Built for engineering teams, Redwood provides model rollouts, observability, and cost controls to simplify moving models into production. Join the launch webinar to see real-world benchmarks and deployment options.
```

Jon P: :thumbsup: from me if legal signs off on the wording.

Sophia L: OK from product side if we replace any comparative percentage language with "lower unit cost" and include the bench link.

Cleo G: Legal quick-pass complete: wording approved. Only caveat — keep any performance figures in the blog body with a clear methodology link.

Alex R: SDR ops confirmed: hidden field implemented, workflow created, queue set to launch-apr26-sdr. Also added a HubSpot list for webinar registrants: "Launch Webinar Apr2026".

Maya C: Great — final ask: can someone run a quick sanity check on the publish checklist? I'll lock assets after thumbs. Checklist: meta image, hero quote, CTAs w/ UTMs, bench link, HubSpot form + hidden field, webhook for webinar registrants, and press list CSV.

Jon P: I can check meta image + hero quote by EOD.

Alex R: I validated CTAs and HubSpot form. Webhook endpoint for registrants -> https://hooks.redwood.com/webinar/registrants is set to receive payloads.

Cleo G: I'll export press CSV and send to PR distribution list after publish.

Maya C: Perfect. Locking publish window: Tue 10am PT. I'll post final assets here once they're locked and ping @channel. Thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
